Part B
Situation
You are Nico Lin. You work for Events Horizon, a company which organises large public events. You are part of a committee responsible for organising the Victoria Cup, a professional women’s tennis tournament.
In order to promote the Victoria Cup to the public, the head of the Victoria Cup project team, Anthony Au, is keen to ensure that the tournament is a success.
You will listen to a Zoom meeting between a young tennis star called Lara Taranova, her agent Victor Laurent and Anthony Au.
Before the recording is played, you will have five minutes to study the Question-Answer Book and the Data File to familiarise yourself with the situation and the tasks.
Complete the tasks by following the instructions in the Question-Answer Book and on the recording. You will find all the information you need in the Question-Answer Book, the Data File and on the recording. As you listen you can make notes on page 3 of the Data File.
You now have five minutes to familiarise yourself with the Question-Answer Book and the Data File.

Email from Anthony Au to Nico Lin
Sent: April 28 2021 10:18 AM
To: Nico Lin
From: Anthony Au
Subject: The Victoria Cup – Things to do
Dear Nico,
These are the three things that I’d like you to do in preparation for the Victoria Cup.
Volunteer Ball Kids
We have decided to choose Changing Young Lives to provide the volunteer ball kids for the Victoria Cup. You need to write an email to Gilbert at Refugee Sanctuary explaining:
• Why we didn’t choose them, i.e. which job requirements they don’t meet.
• Ways that we can contribute to their charity and what Lara has offered to do.
You may want to start by looking at the notice we sent to the charities.
Letter to the Editor from Ms. Singh
You may have seen the letter to the editor in the Hong Kong Press & Journal from a Ms. Geeta Singh complaining about various issues. Please write a letter to the editor in response to Ms Singh’s letter reminding the readers of Ms Singh’s complaints and stating our responses to them. You may have to look at the transcript that Sana made of her conversation with Mr Barnes.
Email to PR Department about Promotional Poster
Our promotional poster for the Victoria Cup has received criticism. Please send an email to Alfred Roi at the PR department making sure that he understands exactly why the poster has to be redesigned.
You can start by looking at the Bon Accord News article.
Thanks again for your help.
Anthony Au
Project Leader
Events Horizon

Organisation Description (100 words max.) RS. is a Hong Kong-based trust that looks after forced migrant children mainly from Africa and South East Asia. We provide a safe and supportive living environment for these vulnerable members of society who have fled dangerous and life-threatening situations, often becoming orphaned in the process. Some of our children speak English but very few of them can speak Cantonese so we help them to lean the basics of the language and integrate into Hong Kong society. The refugee children stay in our centre up until the age of 10, after which they go on to one of our partner charities. Name of Charity: Changing Young Lives Area of Hong Kong: Shek Kip Mei, Hong Kong Number of children: 500 Number of staff: 50 Contact person: Emily Chan ion (100 words max.) The Changing Young Lives Foundation is Organisation Descripti talented underprivileged youngsters in Hong Kong and committed to identifying changing their lives for the better. We operate a coeducational learning institute in Shek Kip Mei where the brightest young people between the ages of 11 and 21 who would otherwise not be able to afford adequate schooling can come free of charge. Our children develop all the essential academic and social skills, becoming proficient in both English and Cantonese, and often going on to study at prestigious universities.

Letter to the Editor of the Hong Kong Press & Journal from Ms. Geeta Singh a
24" April, 2021 Dear Sir/Madam,
Tam writing in regard to your article about the 2021 Victoria Cup which appeared in your newspaper on 21 April as I am keen for the organisers to avoid the mistakes they made last year Tegarding ticketing, First of all, last year, I was annoyed to find that the majority of the seats were Teserved for co rporate sponsors and their guests. As well as being unfair, I can also testify that a Sood number of these corporate sponsor seats are invariably left empty because they don’t show up. Another issue last year was that us real fans could not get a hold of tickets whilst the people who actually got the tickets weren’t even real tennis fans. Ironically, it is exactly these people who end up talking through the matches and putting players off. I would like to know what Events Horizon intends to do about this type of spectator this year. We can’t go on like Previous years when the stewards have been too scared to say anything.
For the benefit of the Hong Kong public and for the health of the sport in general, I urge Events Horizon to address these issues.
Yours faithfully,
Geeta Singh

Bon Accord News article 22 April 2021 Exclusive: Sponsor Joins Chorus of Criticism of Victoria Cup Advertising Campaign Our reporter understands that Sportrite are considering withdrawing their selling sponsorship of the Victoria Cup following a controversial poster campaign promoting ne event. The poster in question featured an image of Suzie Gilmour, ranked number 80 in the world, posing according to one insider, “like an amateur model”. A spokesman for the company, Tim Lewis, revealed that the sponsors had made their expectations very clear to organisers Events Horizon: “We have made it clear to Events Horizon that this was certainly not who we expected to be on the poster. We expected the highest-ranking player.” Mr Lewis added, “We requested a photo of the Player in action on the tennis court, not posing like some sort of high fashion supermodel. At present we certainly don't think the poster is aligned with our company’s aim and vision.” Victoria
